segment.description: Charles Creek (GNIS 01305863) of Warren County, a Collins River tributary (HUC 05130107) whose upper course runs west toward the Van Buren line and whose mouth enters the Collins River at ~35.719,-85.741 on the west side of McMinnville. Identity pinned by catalog HUC 05130107 + Warren County and USGS station 03421150 (Warren Co. 177, HUC 05130107, 13.8 sq mi). Small warmwater presumption of the coordinator's brief is tested below against the agency grab record.
segment.boundaries: Catalog: 'TWRA spring-stocked Warren County creek' (no reach limits given). The single TWRA stocking site is 'Frances Ferry (S1)' at 35.7177,-85.7596 (McMinnville city, spring program, Private Land). The temperature record is at USGS 03421150 'CHARLES CREEK AT DAYLIGHT, TN' (35.7423,-85.8533), upstream of the McMinnville stocked reach on the same creek.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing Collins River tributary above Center Hill Dam (TWRA's muskellunge rule names the Collins River and its tributaries among 'Above Center Hill Dam and tributaries'); no dam on the stocked reach. Barren Fork/Collins drainage per catalog region.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found; TWRA's program here is seasonal spring put-and-take rainbow (2026 schedule: weeks of 3/15, 3/22 and 5/10; single Frances Ferry site in the city).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. The creek has no entry (special regulation or wild-trout listing) on TWRA's Tennessee Trout Regulations page as fetched 2026-09-18.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Six years of USGS grab samples at Daylight show August water up to 26.5 C (1986) and routinely 20-23 C in July-September - warmwater summer conditions on a creek TWRA stocks only three spring weeks per year.
